text:
Sam Reinhart turned 31 on Friday with goals in four straight games and points in five. Nine goals in 16 games is what Florida counts on from him, and this time the chances back it up: 9.82 expected goals (the quality of his looks), more than he's actually scored. His own chance rate is up to 1.84 per 60 minutes from 1.28 last season. The goals are earned.

The points are a little less so. The Panthers have scored 6.5 more goals than their chances deserve with him on the ice, which pads his 16 points, and at 5v5 they're only breaking even on expected goals with him out there. That kind of on-ice luck fades.

He's still the forward Florida trusts against the other team's best. Evolving-Hockey had his competition in the 97th percentile last season, with most of his value coming on the penalty kill, the quiet work behind two Cups. Our range has him around 35 goals. If he keeps getting looks like these, that could be light.
headline: Reinhart's goals are earned, some of his points aren't
